  {"step":2,"file":"fuzz/librawspeed/decoders/TiffDecoders/main.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":61,"var":"buffer","code":"auto ifd = rawspeed::TiffParser::parse(buffer);","note":"The parser interprets the raw bytes as a TIFF-like structure and produces the root IFD used to select the decoder."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::isAppropriateDecoder","line":45,"var":"file","code":"const DataBuffer db(*file, Endianness::little);","note":"The IIQ decoder probes the same attacker-controlled buffer to recognize the file format."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::isAppropriateDecoder","line":49,"var":"db.get<uint32>(8)","code":"return db.get<uint32>(8) == 0x49494949;","note":"The decoder is selected when the input contains the IIQ magic at offset 8."},
  {"step":5,"file":"fuzz/librawspeed/decoders/TiffDecoders/main.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":65,"var":"decoder","code":"auto decoder = std::make_unique<DECODER>(std::move(ifd), &buffer);","note":"The chosen IIQ decoder instance is constructed with the parsed metadata and original input buffer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::decodeRawInternal","line":108,"var":"mFile","code":"const Buffer buf(mFile->getSubView(8));","note":"Decoding continues from the attacker-controlled IIQ payload after the 8-byte TIFF prefix."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::decodeRawInternal","line":130,"var":"correction_meta_data","code":"case 0x110: correction_meta_data = bs.getSubStream(data);","note":"The metadata entry table can supply a correction metadata stream that later drives the vulnerable spline construction."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::decodeRawInternal","line":183,"var":"correction_meta_data","code":"if (correction_meta_data.getSize() != 0 && iiq) CorrectPhaseOneC(correction_meta_data, split_row, split_col);","note":"When correction metadata is present, the decoder dispatches into the Phase One correction path."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::CorrectPhaseOneC","line":287,"var":"meta_data.getSubStream(offset, len)","code":"CorrectQuadrantMultipliersCombined(meta_data.getSubStream(offset, len), split_row, split_col);","note":"The correction entry selects the quadrant-multiplier blob from attacker-controlled metadata and passes it to the vulnerable routine."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::CorrectQuadrantMultipliersCombined","line":304,"var":"data","code":"std::generate_n(std::next(shared_x_coords.begin()), 7, [&data] { return data.getU32(); });","note":"Seven attacker-controlled X coordinates are read from the correction blob."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/librawspeed/decoders/IiqDecoder.cpp","function":"IiqDecoder::CorrectQuadrantMultipliersCombined","line":318,"var":"control_points[quadRow][quadCol]","code":"quadrant.emplace_back(shared_x_coords[i], y_coord);","note":"The routine builds nine control points per quadrant from the attacker-controlled coordinates and multipliers."},
  {"step":12,"file":"src/librawspeed/common/Spline.h","function":"Spline::Spline","line":87,"var":"control_points","code":"explicit Spline(const std::vector<iPoint2D>& control_points)","note":"The control points are handed to the spline constructor, which assumes a valid strictly increasing X sequence spanning 0..65535."},
  {"step":13,"file":"src/librawspeed/common/Spline.h","function":"Spline::prepare","line":58,"var":"segments[i + 1]","code":"Segment& sn = segments[i + 1];","note":"prepare() iterates one element past the last real segment while computing coefficients, so malformed control-point counts/geometry can make it read beyond the intended segment array and trigger the container-overflow read."}
]

print(p.read_text())
